author: Bobby Grayson
description: insert_crashes/2 branches on c.effects: with effects it emits crash clauses, without it it appends warnings '<kind> <tag> in <mod> is not handled in every state; an unmatched cast or call crashes on the BEAM, modelled as ignored (no exit effect in message mode)'. Follow-ups the builder left to the integrator: (1) the catch-all comment in generated files is now only reached by info messages in effects mode; rewording it would change Bank/Lock Gen files; (2) README 'Not modelled yet' bullet about unhandled handle_cast should be removed and the message-mode limitation noted (README deliberately not edited by the builder).
title: Limitation: in message mode (plain Behavior, no exit effect) an uncovered cast/call tag only emits a stderr warning and stays modelled as ignored; generated global catch-all comment 'GenServer would crash (cast) or ignore (info). Modelled as ignore.' left as-is for byte-identity
